## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant milestone or ADR.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Explain material gaps. For research
behavior, include evidence-quality, latency, and cost impact when measured.

## Review

- [ ] The change follows the relevant `AGENTS.md` and architecture boundaries.
- [ ] Documentation/contracts match implemented behavior.
- [ ] Secrets, private evidence, and unrelated generated files are excluded.
- [ ] Targets and fixture behavior are distinguished from measured results.
